identity_boundary: This bundle covers only the Kim Ryu Song described in UN report S/2020/840 as leading a Yanji information-technology-worker team in early 2020. A 2024 Republic of Korea row naming a Kim Ryu Song as the 313 General Bureau's Yanji IT delegation leader remains a strong but unresolved candidate crosswalk awaiting an identity bridge. The UN report leaves the later charged, wanted, ROK-designated, and Umnal Annex 10 same-name records unlinked; a shared alias, selector, explicit cross-reference, or equivalent evidence is required before merging.
